whyNotSingleVariable: The recognizers differ in architecture, runtime and intrinsic transform at once. Arm A is a WASM Tesseract LSTM consuming the preprocessed PNG at its native size; Arm B is an ONNX CTC recognizer that resizes the same PNG to 48x320 in BGR as an unavoidable property of the model. No single dimension separates them, so no causal attribution is claimed.
sharedStartingEvidence: both arms begin from byte-identical frozen source PNG bytes per OCR item
byteIdenticalTensorsNote: The two models do NOT receive byte-identical tensors. They receive identical source evidence followed by architecture-native transforms.
armAIsCarriedForwardNote: Arm A is frozen evidence from merged PR #214, not a new execution. No current-code Tesseract run is authorized in this experiment, so Arm A cannot drift with the repository.

excluded.note: Every entry is false: none of these is used, and none may be introduced after any result exists.

retryPolicy: One primary invocation and one exact repeat per Arm B item. No retry beyond the fixed repeat, and no altered setting after any output exists.
